entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi... um, I bought some shoes a while ago, and I... I just don't think they're right. The website was a little overwhelming. I'm hoping to return them?
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the cycling shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

I honestly don't know. They just feel wrong when I ride. I keep getting blisters on my heels. Maybe the cleats are in a bad spot? I just know they're not working for me and I'd like to get a refund. Can't you just help me?
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear they're causing blisters. That's definitely not the experience we want for our riders. Let me just pull up your account information here... one moment.

Alright, I see your order here. I also see you're a VIP member with us, we really appreciate that. I'm checking our return policy, and it looks like you are well within the 90-day return window. So, yes, we can absolutely process this return for you.
Oh, really? That's such a relief. So I can get a full refund?

That's correct. A full refund to your original payment method. I'm generating a prepaid return label to send to your email right now. And as a thank you for your loyalty and for the trouble, I've also added a $20 credit to your account for your next VeloFit purchase.
Wow, that's amazing! You've been so helpful, Alex. Thank you so much.
You are very welcome. We want to make sure you get the right gear. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
